text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
YEAAAAAAAAAAAH!
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup 
is mine! I truly am the princess, the 
queen, the empress!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? On such a joyous day, so many 
guests aren't smiling...
...Did they say a 
troublemaker isn't fitting...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Listening closely, all I hear are voices 
criticizing me.
To think my rough behavior 
had been hurting so many people without
me knowing...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The thing Trainer had been hiding before 
wasn't a present, either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So you kept those letters of criticism 
away so that they wouldn't meet my
eyes... 
...Am I an unwanted princess?
